# Non-Functional Requirements

## NFR-1: Rendering Performance

Status: draft

The game shall render at 60 frames per second on a 2020 laptop in Google Chrome during standard gameplay (navigation, trading, combat).

## NFR-2: Offline Operation

Status: draft

The game shall operate fully offline with no external CDN dependencies. All assets, scripts, and styles shall be served locally.

## NFR-3: One-Command Startup

Status: draft

The game shall start immediately after `npm install && npm start` with no manual build steps, configuration, or additional commands required.

## NFR-4: Language

Status: draft

All user-facing text in the game shall be in English.
